newsitem.title: FRANCE: France boosts security ahead of Algerian poll.
newsitem.headline: France boosts security ahead of Algerian poll.

text.p: France is stepping up security measures against possible attacks by Moslem rebels in the run-up to Algeria's June 5 general election, Interior Minister Jean-Louis Debre said in an interview published on Friday.
Debre told the Lyon daily Le Progres France was closely following developments in Algeria.
"In agreement with the prime minister, I have decided to continue the Vigipirate plan and reinforce it in some places," he said.
Vigipirate, involving army troops to help police patrol sensitive places, was an operation implemented during a wave of bombings by Algerian rebels which killed eight people in France in 1995.
Major political events in the former French colony have in the past coincided with attacks in France by the rebels, who accuse Paris of supporting the Algiers government.
